起降高峰时段.计算公式: 起降高峰时段 的计算见计算步骤
起降高峰时段.计算步骤:
全局指标+执行航班指标范围下，按小时统计起飞+降落航班架次，取航班量最大的小时时段为高峰时段。
起飞事件=实际起飞时间（REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME）
降落事件=实际降落时间（REAL_LANDIN_TIME）
起降高峰时段.SQL示例:
WITH nums AS (
    -- 生成 0~143 的数字，共 144 个 (24h × 6)
    SELECT ROWNUM - 1 AS n
    FROM all_objects
    WHERE ROWNUM <= 144
),
slots AS (
    -- 完整的 10 分钟桶起点（00:00, 00:10, …, 23:50）
    SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) + n * 10 / 1440 AS bucket_start
    FROM nums
),
-- 离港航班统计（实际起飞时间）
dep_bucket AS (
    SELECT
        s.bucket_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS dep_cnt
    FROM slots s
    LEFT JOIN FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        ON f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
        AND f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME >= s.bucket_start
        AND f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME <  s.bucket_start + 10/1440
        AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
        AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    GROUP BY s.bucket_start
),
-- 到港航班统计（实际落地时间）
arr_bucket AS (
    SELECT
        s.bucket_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS arr_cnt
    FROM slots s
    LEFT JOIN FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        ON f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
        AND f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME >= s.bucket_start
        AND f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME <  s.bucket_start + 10/1440
        AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
        AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    GROUP BY s.bucket_start
),
-- 合并 10 分钟桶数据
bucket_full AS (
    SELECT
        s.bucket_start,
        NVL(d.dep_cnt, 0) AS dep_cnt,
        NVL(a.arr_cnt, 0) AS arr_cnt
    FROM slots s
    LEFT JOIN dep_bucket d ON s.bucket_start = d.bucket_start
    LEFT JOIN arr_bucket a ON s.bucket_start = a.bucket_start
),
-- 滚动窗口函数：当前桶 + 前两个桶 → 30 分钟总和
rolling AS (
    SELECT
        bucket_start,
        SUM(dep_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY bucket_start
                           ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS depart_flights,
        SUM(arr_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY bucket_start
                           ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS arrive_flights,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bucket_start) AS rn,
        LAG(bucket_start, 2) OVER (ORDER BY bucket_start) AS win_start
    FROM bucket_full
)
SELECT flight_date, time_window, depart_flights, arrive_flights, total_flights
FROM (
    SELECT
        TRUNC(bucket_start) AS flight_date,
        TO_CHAR(win_start, 'HH24:MI') || ' - ' || TO_CHAR(bucket_start + 10/1440, 'HH24:MI') AS time_window,
        depart_flights,
        arrive_flights,
        depart_flights + arrive_flights AS total_flights,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY depart_flights + arrive_flights DESC, bucket_start) AS rn
    FROM rolling
    WHERE rn >= 3
)
WHERE rn = 1;

放行延误航班量.计算公式: 放行延误航班量 的计算见计算步骤
放行延误航班量.计算步骤: 全局指标+执行航班指标范围下，出港航班=实际起飞时间统计航班，基础上再增加放行延误时间大于0（CLEARANCE_DELAY_TIME > 0）<说明：航班不正常状态中有延误字典值未采用，因为数据不准确>
放行延误航班量.SQL示例:
WITH

    SELECT DISTINCT
        f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO AS flight_key,

    WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
      AND f2.CLEARANCE_DELAY_TIME > 0 
      AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
      AND TRUNC(f1.PLAN_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-06'
),
delay_arr AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO AS flight_key,

WITH outfield AS (

行李重量.计算公式: 行李重量 的计算见计算步骤
行李重量.计算步骤:
全局指标+执行航班指标范围下，按进出港执行航班的数据口径，用航班ID（FLIGHT_ID
）关联航班动态汇总表（TBH_FIMS_DYN_CALC_TOTAL），取行李重量（BAG_WEIGHT）字段求和。

每日吐(出港)行李重量 = Σ (IS_OFF_IN='D' AND REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME IS NOT NULL 的 BAG_WEIGHT)
每日吞(进港)行李重量 = Σ (IS_OFF_IN='A' AND REAL_LANDIN_TIME IS NOT NULL 的 BAG_WEIGHT)
每日总行李吞吐量 = 吐 + 吞
单位与 BAG_WEIGHT 原始单位一致，不做任何转换。
行李重量.SQL示例:
WITH 
dep_luggage AS (
    SELECT 
        d.FLIGHT_ID,
        fp.LUGGAGE
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
            f1.FLIGHT_NO,
            f2.EXEC_DATE,
            f2.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
            f2.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) d
    LEFT JOIN FORMFILL.FLIGHT_PRODUCTION_ANALYSIS fp 
        ON d.EXEC_DATE = fp.EXEC_DATE
        AND d.CRAFT_NO = fp.CRAFT_NO
        AND d.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD = fp.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD
        AND d.FLIGHT_NO = fp.FLIGHT_NO  
        AND d.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA || '-' || d.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA = fp.LEG
        AND fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT != 0
    WHERE d.rn = 1
),
arr_luggage AS (
    SELECT 
        a.FLIGHT_ID,
        fp.LUGGAGE
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
            f1.FLIGHT_NO,
            f2.EXEC_DATE,
            f2.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
            f2.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) a
    LEFT JOIN FORMFILL.FLIGHT_PRODUCTION_ANALYSIS fp 
        ON a.EXEC_DATE = fp.EXEC_DATE
        AND a.CRAFT_NO = fp.CRAFT_NO
        AND a.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD = fp.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD
        AND a.FLIGHT_NO = fp.FLIGHT_NO  
        AND a.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA || '-' || a.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA = fp.LEG
        AND fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT != 0
    WHERE a.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(NVL(LUGGAGE, 0)) FROM dep_luggage) AS depart_luggage,
    (SELECT SUM(NVL(LUGGAGE, 0)) FROM arr_luggage) AS arrive_luggage,
    (SELECT SUM(NVL(LUGGAGE, 0)) FROM dep_luggage) + (SELECT SUM(NVL(LUGGAGE, 0)) FROM arr_luggage) AS total_luggage
FROM DUAL;

进港旅客量(人次).SQL示例:
WITH 
arr_unique AS (

靠桥时长.计算公式: 靠桥时长 的计算见计算步骤
靠桥时长.计算步骤:
全局指标+执行航班指标范围下，用出港航班ID（FLIGHT_ID
）关联进港航班的关联航班ID（ASSOCIATED_FLIGHT_ID）筛选出从进港到出港的地服保障全流程范围。
靠桥时长=实际离桥时间（结束）-实际靠桥时间（开始）
靠桥时长.SQL示例:
WITH 
arr_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        t.FLIGHT_ID,
        t.flight_date,
        t.ASSOCIATED_FLIGHT_ID,
        t.CRAFT_NO,
        t.REAL_BLOCK_ON_TIME,
        t.REAL_BY_BRIDGE_TIME,
        t.REAL_OFF_BRIDGE_TIME
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.ASSOCIATED_FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME AS flight_date,
            f2.REAL_BLOCK_ON_TIME,
            f2.REAL_BY_BRIDGE_TIME,
            f2.REAL_OFF_BRIDGE_TIME,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
dep_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        t.FLIGHT_ID,
        t.CRAFT_NO,
        t.REAL_BLOCK_OFF_TIME
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f2.REAL_BLOCK_OFF_TIME,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
valid_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        TRUNC(a.flight_date) AS flight_date,
        (a.REAL_OFF_BRIDGE_TIME - a.REAL_BY_BRIDGE_TIME) * 24 * 60 AS bridge_minutes
    FROM arr_unique a
    INNER JOIN dep_unique d ON d.FLIGHT_ID = a.ASSOCIATED_FLIGHT_ID
    WHERE a.CRAFT_NO = d.CRAFT_NO
      AND d.REAL_BLOCK_OFF_TIME > a.REAL_BLOCK_ON_TIME
)
SELECT 
    flight_date,
    ROUND(AVG(bridge_minutes), 2) AS avg_bridge_minutes
FROM valid_pairs
GROUP BY flight_date
ORDER BY flight_date DESC;

arr_unique AS (

        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,

上座率(客座率).计算公式: 上座率(客座率) 的计算见计算步骤
上座率(客座率).计算步骤:
进港上座率=进港人次/进港航班可供座位数
出港上座率=出港人次/出港航班可供座位数
总上座率=旅客吞吐量/航班可供座位总数（含进港、出港）
上座率(客座率).SQL示例:
WITH 
-- 进港去重航班
arr_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        a.FLIGHT_ID,
        a.EXEC_DATE,
        a.CRAFT_NO,
        a.FLIGHT_NO,
        a.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
        a.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
        a.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f2.EXEC_DATE,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f2.FLIGHT_NO,
            f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
            f2.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
            f2.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) a
    WHERE a.rn = 1
),
-- 出港去重航班
dep_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        d.FLIGHT_ID,
        d.EXEC_DATE
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f2.EXEC_DATE,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) d
    WHERE d.rn = 1
),
-- 出港座位（去重后关联座位表）
dep_seat AS (
    SELECT 
        d.FLIGHT_ID,
        d.EXEC_DATE,
        d.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
        d.FLIGHT_NO,
        d.CRAFT_NO,
        d.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
        d.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA,
        fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
            f1.FLIGHT_NO,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f2.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
            f2.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA,
            f2.EXEC_DATE,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) d
    LEFT JOIN FORMFILL.FLIGHT_PRODUCTION_ANALYSIS fp 
        ON d.EXEC_DATE = fp.EXEC_DATE
        AND d.CRAFT_NO = fp.CRAFT_NO
        AND d.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD = fp.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD
        AND d.FLIGHT_NO = fp.FLIGHT_NO  
        AND d.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA || '-' || d.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA = fp.LEG
        AND fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT != 0
    WHERE d.rn = 1
),
-- 进港座位（去重后关联座位表）
arr_seat AS (
    SELECT 
        a.FLIGHT_ID,
        a.EXEC_DATE,
        a.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
        a.FLIGHT_NO,
        a.CRAFT_NO,
        a.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
        a.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA,
        fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
            f1.FLIGHT_NO,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f2.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
            f2.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA,
            f2.EXEC_DATE,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) a
    LEFT JOIN FORMFILL.FLIGHT_PRODUCTION_ANALYSIS fp 
        ON a.EXEC_DATE = fp.EXEC_DATE
        AND a.CRAFT_NO = fp.CRAFT_NO
        AND a.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD = fp.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD
        AND a.FLIGHT_NO = fp.FLIGHT_NO  
        AND a.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA || '-' || a.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA = fp.LEG
        AND fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT != 0
    WHERE a.rn = 1
),
-- 旅客量汇总
arr_pax AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(NVL(fp.ADULT_COUNT, 0) + NVL(fp.CHILDREN_COUNT, 0) + NVL(fp.BABY_COUNT, 0)) AS arrival_pax
    FROM arr_unique a
    LEFT JOIN FORMFILL.FLIGHT_PRODUCTION_ANALYSIS fp 
        ON a.EXEC_DATE = fp.EXEC_DATE
        AND a.CRAFT_NO = fp.CRAFT_NO
        AND a.FLIGHT_NO = fp.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || fp.FLIGHT_NO  
        AND a.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA || '-' || a.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA = fp.LEG
        AND fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT != 0
),
dep_pax AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(NVL(t.DEP_DPSR_DEPE_NUM, 0)) AS departure_pax
    FROM dep_unique d
    LEFT JOIN FIMS.TBH_FIMS_DYN_CALC_TOTAL t ON d.FLIGHT_ID = t.FLIGHT_ID
),
-- 座位汇总
dep_seat_sum AS (
    SELECT SUM(NVL(AVAILABLE_SEAT, 0)) AS depart_seat FROM dep_seat
),
arr_seat_sum AS (
    SELECT SUM(NVL(AVAILABLE_SEAT, 0)) AS arrive_seat FROM arr_seat
)
SELECT 
    dep_pax.departure_pax,
    arr_pax.arrival_pax,
    dep_pax.departure_pax + arr_pax.arrival_pax AS total_pax,
    dep_seat_sum.depart_seat,
    arr_seat_sum.arrive_seat,
    dep_seat_sum.depart_seat + arr_seat_sum.arrive_seat AS total_seat,
    -- 出港上座率
    ROUND(100.0 * dep_pax.departure_pax / NULLIF(dep_seat_sum.depart_seat, 0), 2) AS dep_load_factor,
    -- 进港上座率
    ROUND(100.0 * arr_pax.arrival_pax / NULLIF(arr_seat_sum.arrive_seat, 0), 2) AS arr_load_factor,
    -- 总上座率
    ROUND(100.0 * (dep_pax.departure_pax + arr_pax.arrival_pax) / NULLIF(dep_seat_sum.depart_seat + arr_seat_sum.arrive_seat, 0), 2) AS total_load_factor
FROM dep_pax, arr_pax, dep_seat_sum, arr_seat_sum;

开舱门准时率.计算公式: 开舱门准时率 的计算见计算步骤
开舱门准时率.计算步骤: 开舱门准时率 = (准时开舱门的进港航班数 ÷ 进港航班总数) × 100%
开舱门准时率.SQL示例:
WITH 
arr_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        t.FLIGHT_ID,
        t.REAL_LANDIN_TIME,

WITH

      AND FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
),
-- 执行航班量（出港）
dep_exec AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO AS flight_key,

        f1.IS_OFF_IN
    FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1

    WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'

      AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
      AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
),
-- 执行航班量（进港）
arr_exec AS (

        f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO AS flight_key,
        f1.PLAN_TIME,

    FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1

    (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_plan) AS arr_plan_flights,
    (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_exec) AS arr_exec_flights,
    ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_exec) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_plan), 0), 2) AS arr_exec_rate,
    (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dep_plan) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_plan) AS total_plan_flights,
    (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dep_exec) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_exec) AS total_exec_flights,
    ROUND(100.0 * ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dep_exec) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_exec)) 
          / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dep_plan) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM arr_plan), 0), 2) AS total_exec_rate
FROM DUAL;

地服保障节点时长(平均保障时长).指标名称: 地服保障节点时长(平均保障时长)
地服保障节点时长(平均保障时长).计算公式: 地服保障节点时长(平均保障时长) 的计算见计算步骤
地服保障节点时长(平均保障时长).计算步骤: 平均保障时长用于衡量进港航班从挡轮挡（停稳）到关联出港航班撤轮挡（推出）之间的地面服务时间，反映机场地面保障效率。
地服保障节点时长(平均保障时长).SQL示例:
WITH 
arr_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        t.FLIGHT_ID,
        t.flight_date,
        t.ASSOCIATED_FLIGHT_ID,
        t.CRAFT_NO,
        t.REAL_BLOCK_ON_TIME,
        t.REAL_BY_BRIDGE_TIME,
        t.REAL_OFF_BRIDGE_TIME,
        t.DEPARTURE_START_TIME,
        t.DEPARTURE_END_TIME
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.ASSOCIATED_FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME AS flight_date,
            f2.REAL_BLOCK_ON_TIME,
            f2.REAL_BY_BRIDGE_TIME,
            f2.REAL_OFF_BRIDGE_TIME,
            f2.DEPARTURE_START_TIME,
            f2.DEPARTURE_END_TIME,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
-- 出港：去重并获取保障节点时间
dep_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        t.FLIGHT_ID,
        t.flight_date,
        t.CRAFT_NO,
        t.REAL_BLOCK_OFF_TIME,
        t.REAL_BEGIN_BOARD_TIME,
        t.REAL_END_BOARD_TIME,
        t.REAL_START_CLEAN_TIME,
        t.REAL_END_CLEAN_TIME,
        t.REAL_MEAL_START_TIME,
        t.REAL_MEAL_END_TIME,
        t.REAL_START_SUPPLY_TIME,
        t.REAL_END_SUPPLY_TIME,
        t.REAL_END_DEICIE_TIME,
        t.REAL_START_DEICE_TIME
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME AS flight_date,
            f2.REAL_BLOCK_OFF_TIME,
            f2.REAL_BEGIN_BOARD_TIME,
            f2.REAL_END_BOARD_TIME,
            f2.REAL_START_CLEAN_TIME,
            f2.REAL_END_CLEAN_TIME,
            f2.REAL_MEAL_START_TIME,
            f2.REAL_MEAL_END_TIME,
            f2.REAL_START_SUPPLY_TIME,
            f2.REAL_END_SUPPLY_TIME,
            f2.REAL_END_DEICIE_TIME,
            f2.REAL_START_DEICE_TIME,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
valid_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        TRUNC(a.flight_date) AS flight_date,
        (d.REAL_BLOCK_OFF_TIME - a.REAL_BLOCK_ON_TIME) * 24 * 60 AS service_minutes, --总保障时长
        (a.REAL_OFF_BRIDGE_TIME - a.REAL_BY_BRIDGE_TIME) * 24 * 60 AS bridge_minutes,--靠桥时长
        (a.DEPARTURE_END_TIME - a.DEPARTURE_START_TIME) * 24 * 60 AS departure_minutes,--下客时长
        (d.REAL_END_BOARD_TIME - d.REAL_BEGIN_BOARD_TIME) * 24 * 60 AS board_minutes,--登机时长
        (d.REAL_END_CLEAN_TIME - d.REAL_START_CLEAN_TIME) * 24 * 60 AS clean_minutes,--保洁时长
        (d.REAL_MEAL_END_TIME - d.REAL_MEAL_START_TIME) * 24 * 60 AS meal_minutes,	--配餐时长
        (d.REAL_END_SUPPLY_TIME - d.REAL_START_SUPPLY_TIME) * 24 * 60 AS supply_minutes, --加油时长
        (d.REAL_END_DEICIE_TIME - d.REAL_START_DEICE_TIME) * 24 * 60 AS deicie_minutes --除冰时长
    FROM arr_unique a
    INNER JOIN dep_unique d ON d.FLIGHT_ID = a.ASSOCIATED_FLIGHT_ID
    WHERE a.CRAFT_NO = d.CRAFT_NO
      AND d.REAL_BLOCK_OFF_TIME > a.REAL_BLOCK_ON_TIME
)
SELECT 
    flight_date,
    COUNT(1) AS total_pairs,
    ROUND(AVG(service_minutes), 2) AS avg_service_minutes, 	--平均总保障时长
    ROUND(AVG(bridge_minutes), 2) AS avg_bridge_minutes,	--平均靠桥时长
    ROUND(AVG(departure_minutes), 2) AS avg_departure_minutes,	--平均下客时长
    ROUND(AVG(board_minutes), 2) AS avg_board_minutes,	--平均登机时长
    ROUND(AVG(clean_minutes), 2) AS avg_clean_minutes,	--平均保洁时长
    ROUND(AVG(meal_minutes), 2) AS avg_meal_minutes,	--平均配餐时长
    ROUND(AVG(supply_minutes), 2) AS avg_supply_minutes,	--平均加油时长
    ROUND(AVG(deicie_minutes), 2) AS avg_deicie_minutes	--平均加油时长
FROM valid_pairs
GROUP BY flight_date
ORDER BY flight_date DESC;

_LEFT_JOIN_TEMPLATE.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA:
如果要获取到达航站详细信息（航站四字码、中文名、英文名、航站简称）
拼接规则：LEFT JOIN FIMS.TB_AIRPORT arr ON arr.AIRPORT_IATA = f2.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA AND arr.IS_DELETE = 0
拼接可选字段：arr.AIRPORT_ICAO AS ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_ICAO,arr.CHINESE_NAME AS ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_CHINESE_NAME,arr.ENGLISH_NAME AS ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_ENGLISH_NAME,		
  arr.SHORT_NAME AS ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_SHORT_NAME
_LEFT_JOIN_TEMPLATE.DELAY_REASON:
只要涉及到延误原因或者取消原因，必须获取延误中文名
拼接规则：LEFT JOIN FIMS.TB_ABNORMAL_REASON r ON f2.DELAY_REASON = r.CODE AND r.IS_DELETE = 0
拼接可选字段：r.CHINESE_NAME AS ABNORMAL_REASON_CHINESE_NAME
_LEFT_JOIN_TEMPLATE.FORMFILL_JOIN:
如果要获取旅客量或座位数等航线统计信息，需关联 FORMFILL.FLIGHT_PRODUCTION_ANALYSIS
拼接规则：LEFT JOIN FORMFILL.FLIGHT_PRODUCTION_ANALYSIS fp 
  ON f2.EXEC_DATE = fp.EXEC_DATE
  AND f2.CRAFT_NO = fp.CRAFT_NO
  AND f2.FLIGHT_NO = fp.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || fp.FLIGHT_NO
  AND f2.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA || '-' || f2.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA = fp.LEG
  AND fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT != 0
拼接可选字段：fp.ADULT_COUNT, fp.CHILDREN_COUNT, fp.BABY_COUNT, fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT
注意：进港旅客 = ADULT_COUNT + CHILDREN_COUNT + BABY_COUNT；出港旅客使用 TBH_FIMS_DYN_CALC_TOTAL.DEP_DPSR_DEPE_NUM
